_note: Single source of truth for what may ship. A PUBLIC_BUILD=1 build must strip every class whose cleared is not true. Flip a flag only after written permission from sunniva (an email reply is enough) and record it in docs/ASSET_REGISTER.md. Per class: paths = shipped files/dirs of the class (every shipped file under assets/ must belong to a class), fields = JSON keys removed from shipped data, hosts = hostnames that must not appear in a public build while the class is not cleared.

lyrics.note: Needs her permission. Lyric text is shown only if data/lyrics/<trackId>.json exists AND its permission is 'granted' (public) or 'private-preview' (private build only).

coverArt.note: Apple artwork URLs. Private preview only. Load after user action. Never on receipts.

photosOfHer.note: Instagram/CD photos. Max 3-5, private preview only.

previewAudio.note: Apple 30s previews, streamed from Apple's URL on user click. Never re-hosted.

guitarPhotos.note: Source of the catalogue photos is unknown. Covers everything derived from them (DOM guitar layers, Meshy model). Private preview only; replace with own photos or CC0 before public.

collageCutouts.note: Vibe-board pieces: text snippets are fine; photos/clip-art may belong to others. Replace before public.

filmTextures.note: Reference images only (Pinterest-like), never shipped. Production uses procedural textures.

magazineLetters.note: Provenance of the 130 scans in the Arctic Monkeys archive is not documented by the project. Confirm they are the owner's own scans or replace.

fontsOFL.note: Only SIL OFL fonts. Ship OFL.txt next to every font file.
